graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
FRESH CONCEPT (borrowed from fractal geometry / chaos theory -- Mandelbrot & H.E. Hurst, R/S analysis from hydrology; estimated via DFA, Peng et al. 1994). Confirmed ABSENT from factor_registry.json (373 factors) and from all prior research artifacts -- mathematically distinct from the already-falsified frog-in-the-pan / information-discreteness factor (WT-D20260529_002): self-similarity / long-range dependence of the return path, NOT up/down-day discreteness.

MECHANISM: Classical momentum (M01 12-1) implicitly assumes the recent trend persists. Persistence is heterogeneous across names. The Hurst exponent H measures long-memory of the price path: H>0.5 = persistent/self-similar (trend likely to continue), H~0.5 = random walk, H<0.5 = anti-persistent (mean-reverting, momentum likely to reverse). Thesis: momentum signal quality is conditional on path persistence; low-H names are where momentum dilutes and where momentum CRASHES originate (anti-persistent rebounds, Daniel-Moskowitz 2016).

CONSTRUCTION (alpha-research chooses & A/B tests the operationalization autonomously): candidate forms = (a) H-scaled momentum: signal = momentum_12_1 * g(H) with high-H amplified / low-H damped; (b) H-gated regime split: take momentum in high-H names, take reversal (or flat) in low-H names; (c) pure H cross-sectional factor as baseline. Estimator: rolling-window H (default ~252d, also test 126d/504d) via DFA (robust to non-stationary drift) cross-checked with R/S. Compare against M01/M08/M13 to prove orthogonality (target |corr|<0.6 vs existing momentum cluster) and incremental signal.

EXPECTED_ROLE: core / offensive momentum-quality alpha with native momentum-crash mitigation (low-H = crash candidates filtered/down-weighted). Aims to lift the realized portfolio-alpha of momentum above its empirical KR ceiling, not to be a defensive sleeve.

WHY_NOW: (1) PG0 gap vector sleeve_needs=core_alpha, target SR 2.5 / CAGR 16 / MDD 25, regime NEUTRAL. (2) Our own KR finding: momentum is the only standalone factor with positive OOS retention in the 25-stock long-only box, BUT its portfolio-alpha t sits at a ceiling (~2.2) below the graduation HARD gate (PORT_t>=2.95). Separating persistent-trend momentum from mean-reverting noise directly targets that ceiling rather than adding another diluting variant. (3) Momentum crashes occur in anti-persistent rebound regimes; low-H detection is a native, per-name crash filter complementary to our RAMP_04 momentum-crash overlay.

PIT / CONSTRAINTS: rolling/expanding window only, all lookbacks Date<=sig_date (C1); DFA detrending must NOT use full-sample (C1/C7); Z_Score_Aligned cross-sectional (C13); compute from rawdata (Close/Ret) via the standard compute_momentum.R pattern, load via load_month_factors (C15). Universe KOSPI200 u KOSDAQ150, long-only, max 25 names, weight bounds [0,0.20], 15bps delta cost, liquidity 20d ADTV>=2e8.

HONEST RISK (AX-000 reporting): AX-007 applies -- single-sleeve long-only top-25 may break the cross-sectional-signal -> portfolio-alpha translation even if rank-IC is strong. Graduation to capital is NOT presumed. A real-but-non-graduating signal is a valid outcome and routes to screening-tier consumption (OVERLAY_CANDIDATE / FR_RCMA / DPL_FEATURE) per measurement-graduation 2-tier. Measurement is real-computation only (canonical_screen_bt / build_bt_result); proxy hand-calc graduation is forbidden.
